_note: Extra AI providers, all OpenAI-compatible (POST {baseUrl}/chat/completions). Read by fetch_stories.py and scripts/generate-briefing.mjs. A provider switches on by itself when its key env var is set (a GitHub Actions secret) — no code change. Override per provider with <NAME>_MODEL / <NAME>_BASE_URL env vars (NAME upper-cased). Model names and free-tier limits drift: if one starts failing, read the error in fetch-log.txt first. 'tier': 'free' = has a free allowance, tried before paid ones for routine sections.

providers.name: github
providers.note: GitHub Models. In Actions this is the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN (workflow needs permissions: models: read) — no new account or secret. Free allowance is small (about 150 requests/day on low-tier models).

providers.name: groq
providers.note: Free tier with a rate limit; console.groq.com. llama-3.3-70b-versatile was retired 2026-08-16; gpt-oss is a reasoning model, so it gets low effort and extra token headroom.

providers.name: openrouter
providers.note: ':free' models rotate without notice — set OPENROUTER_MODEL if this one disappears.

providers.name: deepseek
providers.note: No free tier; very cheap per token.
